decision: Determine which native geometric views preserve distinctions required by the maintained EDCM readouts and whether metric-origin geometry supports orthogonal axes.
origin_profile: ordered EDCM construction terms, each closed by UCHC at unit radius, then closed as one sequence at unit radius
observation_profile: exact raw round text, partitioned into maximal whitespace and non-whitespace runs; each run participates as one closed UCHC object; closed rounds and literal LF separators participate at the next scale
recursive_alignment: Each occurrence is addressed by its parent-local ordinal depth, counted from the most recent child. Retain each local ray and both results of every closed node. Compare equal addresses and roles in their own local SPACE frames.

comparison.distance: Euclidean norm of differences in the union of addressed planar vector coordinates
comparison.projection: dot product with the unit vector of the origin field
comparison.absence: Union-space zero extension is an explicit comparison operation. Record unmatched coordinate supports separately; retain presence of exact zero vectors.
comparison.numeric: UCNS native display of exact Point expressions, binary64. Preserve original records and unrounded values. Undefined direction is typed null.
comparison.monotonic_hypothesis: For unsigned legacy readouts, larger proxy could correspond to smaller origin distance, larger signed projection, or larger cosine. Test each separately at round and prefix grain; signed O direction is unresolved.
